rules.name: xoga750-01-trade-id-and-valuation-date
rules.sql: SELECT business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, date_id, updated_by, updated_timestamp, created_timestamp FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY business_unit
SELECT date_id, value_date, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table_gpc

SELECT uuid, name, transaction_type, reference_format, number_of_digits, reset_value, transaction_status, created_timestamp FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND transaction_type = 'tradeId' ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC

SELECT 'view' AS source, v.business_unit, v.trade_id_prefix, NULL AS financial_year FROM opera.helper_fetch_tradeid_prefix_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant UNION ALL SELECT 'mapping' AS source, NULL AS business_unit, m.trade_id_prefix, m.financial_year FROM opera.financial_year_trade_id_mapping_table m WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant UNION ALL SELECT 'financial_year' AS source, NULL AS business_unit, NULL AS trade_id_prefix, f.financial_year || ' ' || f.start_date::text || ' to ' || f.end_date::text AS financial_year FROM opera.financial_year_table f WHERE f.tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY 1, 2, 4

SELECT s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' AS business_unit, s.last_sequence_id, s.start_value, s.end_value, s.sequence_type, s.parent_uuid, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f WHERE f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.uuid::text = s.parent_uuid AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId') AS parent_is_tradeid_format, s.updated_by, s.updated_timestamp, s.created_timestamp, s.uuid FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY 1, s.created_timestamp DESC

SELECT b.business_unit, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_fetch_tradeid_prefix_view p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(p.business_unit) = upper(b.business_unit)) AS prefix_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s JOIN opera.oga_configservice_transactionidformatmaster f ON f.uuid::text = s.parent_uuid AND f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND f.transaction_type = 'tradeId' WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' ILIKE b.business_unit) AS sequence_rows_via_format, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.sequence_criteria ->> 'businessUnit' ILIKE b.business_unit) AS sequence_rows_via_tenant FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_unit FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant) b ORDER BY b.business_unit

SELECT trade_id, business_unit, count(*) AS rows_found, max(version_no) AS max_version FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND trade_id IN (:oldFirstGpc, :oldLastGpc, :oldFirstCfs) GROUP BY trade_id, business_unit ORDER BY trade_id, business_unit

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, count(*) AS numeric_ids, max(substr(trade_id, length(:fy) + 1)::bigint) AS max_suffix FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(business_unit) IN (upper(:gpcBu), upper(:cfsBu)) AND trade_id ~ '^TR-FY-2026-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY upper(business_unit) ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS numeric_ids, max(cast(mid(trade_id, 12) AS unsigned)) AS max_suffix FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_gpc WHERE trade_id LIKE 'TR-FY-2026-%' AND mid(trade_id, 12) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

expect.reason: the date reference reads this table; it must have the BUs
dev holds one tradeId format row per BU that has a sequence row (9 seen on 25 Nov); the service takes the newest one
legacy gives one prefix for gpc
gpc must be a BU in the valuation date table, else the GPC run has no date for it
reserveTradeIds needs exactly one sequence row for gpc; 0 gives the fallback TRN000001
the CFS dump also shows TRN000001, so cfs is checked the same way
one prefix row for gpc in the view the service reads
